title: docs(spec): a declared never-string-capable search column is admitted but contributes no clause
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Ffn7zen4zj6cFnXv7bG1yJ)_

Fixes #29546

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Dispatched by `domain:spec#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbahe4v7GBD94QeSnir`; dev = card thread `session_01JQwxbWkmiSMGh5SFWcG7XY`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改注释。`resolveSearchFieldResolution` 的 declared 分支说明和对应测试注释,改为「从不存字符串的列(如 `json`)仍可声明、进入搜索集,但搜索展开不给它出子句」。
- 为什么改:#29502 之后 `$search` 展开跳过这类列,旧注释仍说 json 列「a scan that CAN match」,作者和 AI 会以为把 json 字段放进 `searchableFields` 能搜到东西。
- 风险与回滚:零行为改动,无 schema、无接受值变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts`(declared 分支两条列表项)、`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.test.ts`(CONTROL 用例注释)、`.changeset/29546-declared-search-column-no-clause-comment.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src` 只见注释行变化;`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/search-fields.test.ts` 应 50/50 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts`, the declared-branch docblock on `resolveSearchFieldResolution`: a declared `lookup` or `json` column is ADMITTED to the set, and what it contributes is the expansion's call (`expandSearchToFilter`, `@objectstack/objectql`). A single-valued `lookup` becomes an `$icontains` over the stored foreign key, a scan that can match. A column whose declared type can never hold a string (the text-operator door's `door-refusal` verdict, `textOperatorDoorVerdict`) contributes NO clause, and a set made only of such columns answers no rows, never an error. Only "there is no column at all" is refused, as before. The `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` docblock in the same file said the same stale json sentence; it now says a declared json or lookup column is admitted because a stored column exists. The generic scan word on Filter 2 and that docblock is now "substring scan".
- `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.test.ts`, the CONTROL case comment: the same reading, single-valued lookup. The assertion is unchanged.
- `.changeset/29546-declared-search-column-no-clause-comment.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch. The docblock sits on an exported function and ships in `dist/data/index.d.ts` (measured below), so the published text changes.

## Why

The declared-branch text is the written contract authors and AI read to decide what to put in `searchableFields`. Since #29502 (#29394) the expansion skips never-string-capable columns, so "a scan that CAN match" for `json` was false. `lookup` is in `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` (verdict `passes`), so it still matches and keeps that wording.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/search-fields.test.ts` at `691a1581b`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 50 passed (50).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour moved.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured on `origin/main` `ff827bcf`: `packages/objectql/src/search-filter.ts` `fieldClausesForTerm` returns no clause when `neverHoldsText(meta)`, which is `textOperatorDoorVerdict(...) === 'door-refusal'`; `json` sits in `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES` (verdict `door-refusal`). A single-valued `lookup` falls to the default `$icontains` clause, so the old text also said `$contains` where the expansion emits `$icontains`; the new text says `$icontains`.
- Changeset decision: the card said "no changeset unless the gate asks". The os-dev standard (published = what `files[]` ships) wins on conflict: after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `grep -c "contributes NO clause" packages/spec/dist/data/index.d.ts` = 1 and the old phrase = 0 (positive control: `SCANNABILITY` hits the same file on the base build). So a patch changeset rides.
- Not changed here, same stale sentence: `packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts` docblock (about L95 to L100) still says a declared json column is "a scan that CAN match". Outside this card's file surface; named in the report for the seat.
- Contract review 6587379147 should-fixes applied in `691a1581`: no formula in the no-clause bullet (Filter 2 drops every formula before admission), same in the changeset.
- `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md` carry the old phrase in released entries; release-owned, untouched.
